entries.note: genesis: free local Tier 1 audit front door; zero network enforced by a socket guard in the audit process and in the scorer-probe subprocess, not asserted in prose

from the first run on a real 103-file project: collapse repeated not-run lines to one per reason, tighten the scorer-candidate filter so validators and test helpers are counted as ruled out rather than reported as scorers, and add the single recommended next step the brief requires

independent tools-on review found the zero-network claim false on 5 of 8 escape routes: shrink the claim to what is enforced, add a preflighted network-namespace sandbox for the probe, close _socket and the ssl-breaking guard, refuse a non-deterministic --scorer, stop relaying exception and stderr text, and turn every silent cap into a printed finding

second review round: classify a module named at runtime as executing and stop presenting the classifier as a boundary, read only the probe's own framed result line through a typed whitelist so a scorer cannot forge a verdict, and bind the project back into the sandbox so a project under /tmp is not reported as a broken scorer
